scope: Six 64-step arms in one catalogue: the published read, the M20 two-path read, the M21 level composition, the sum without the envelope, and the two free-channel compositions with a coarse local stencil on the fixed lattice. Every arm is scored read-only at the standing 0.0 boundary and over the standing 81-point grid, every arm's read is rebuilt stage by stage, and every free-channel arm is split into lattice, pooled-free, local-stencil and summed readings.

mechanism.name: coarse-local-stencil
mechanism.definition: five taps - the cell's own coarse box and its four neighbours - read from the dimension-wide coarse feature map at equal divisions of the capture, plus the cell's row and column embeddings, through a two-layer head whose output projection starts at zero
mechanism.why_fixed: the divisions are of the capture, not of the decoded lattice, so the channel cannot inherit the placement error that made pixel-local features fail
mechanism.why_coarse: a box average is insensitive to sub-cell misplacement: the stencil reads a region, not a sample
mechanism.identity_at_zero: the output projection is zero at step zero, so the read is bit-identical to the same arm without it
mechanism.parts: the local read is kept beside the sum, so the pooled free channel and the stencil are scored exactly

ablation.question: is the crossing rule's gain from being trained in the loop, or does applying it afterwards to a read trained without it do the same?

post_hoc.applied: stack_contiguous then otsu_board on the arm's own weights

source_fingerprints.reading: the eight arms run under two source fingerprints that differ only by the added de-mean branch; the proof compares the archived and current sources on one checkpoint and finds the read and every recorded part bit-identical for modes 0 and 1, and no earlier arm declares mode 2

declaration_of_change: M21 relaxed the M20 coupling of the sum to the envelope; M22 adds a declared field beside it. Neither changes an existing arm's declared values, so the M20 and M21 checkpoints are reproduced bit-for-bit inside this catalogue.

aliasing_guard.rule: each sweep's weights equal its own study's checkpoint, the control and every unchanged arm reproduce their earlier checkpoints exactly, and each arm differs from the control in exactly its declared fields

reference.role: reference-only, each measured in its own catalogue and none re-measured or re-verdict'd here
